title: IT Operations Analyst - Especialista Senior
description:
Breve descrição:

Responsável pelo suporte, operação e evolução dos sistemas críticos de integração e APIs da companhia, atuando na resolução de problemas técnicos de média e alta complexidade, sustentação de ambientes cloud e suporte às demandas de projetos estratégicos.

Principais atividades:

  • Operar e manter plataformas de APIs, integração e VAS com foco em disponibilidade, desempenho e confiabilidade.
  • Monitorar e atuar proativamente na prevenção de incidentes em ambientes críticos e de missão essencial ao negócio
  • Promover soluções técnicas adequadas através da interação com áreas e equipes envolvidas nos projetos e sistemas.- Atuar na resolução de incidentes, troubleshooting avançado e análise de causa raiz.
  • Realizar análise e otimização de performance de aplicações, integrações e serviços.
  • Participar da definição de arquitetura de soluções sob a ótica operacional, observabilidade e resiliência.
  • Executar atividades de change, deploy, rollback e recuperação de serviços críticos.
  • Atuar na sustentação de ambientes cloud e multiplataforma.
  • Administrar e evoluir ferramentas de monitoramento, observabilidade e automação operacional.
  • Realizar gestão técnica de fornecedores e abertura de chamados para tratativas especializadas
  • Apoiar e desenvolver iniciativas de automação operacional utilizando inteligência artificial, agentes inteligentes e tecnologias correlatas.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de operação, disponibilidade e resposta a incidentes.

Experiência, conhecimentos e formação:

-Experiência em operação e suporte de sistemas críticos de APIs, plataformas de integração e VAS.

  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas distribuídas, microsserviços e comunicação entre sistemas.- Experiência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, OCI, Azure ou GCP).
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de gerenciamento de APIs e integração.- Experiência em troubleshooting e análise de incidentes de alta complexidade.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade, monitoramento e análise de logs.
  • Experiência com automação operacional e scripting (Shell, Python ou similares).
  • Conhecimento de redes, protocolos de comunicação, balanceamento de carga e segurança de aplicações.
  • Experiência com práticas de alta disponibilidade, recuperação de desastres e continuidade operacional.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de SRE, ITIL e gestão de incidentes.
  • Experiência no uso de Inteligência Artificial aplicada à operação de TI.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento, configuração e utilização de agentes de IA para automação de processos operacionais.

-Graduação completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

title: Farmacêutico - Responsável Técnico (Industria)
description:

REQUISITOS

  • Ensino Superior completo em Farmácia;
  • CRF ativo e regularizado;

  • Conhecimento em legislação sanitária e processos junto à VISA/ANVISA;

title: Gerente Geral de Loja - Tangará da Serra/MT
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Gestor(a) de Loja, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Planejar, organizar e controlar as rotinas de loja, acompanhando as atividades diárias e garantindo que todos os processos operacionais estejam dentro do prazo e dos padrões estabelecidos pela cia;
  • Gerir, orientar e desenvolver a equipe, alinhando tarefas e apoiando no crescimento profissional de cada associado(a);
  • Garantir o atingimento dos resultados de venda e demais indicadores de loja, desenvolvendo estratégias para alcançar as metas estabelecidas;
  • Garantir conformidade com políticas e procedimentos, assegurando que todos os processos estejam alinhados com as diretrizes institucionais e requisitos legais;
  • Realizar a gestão financeira, desde o fluxo de caixa, despesas operacionais e demais indicadores financeiros, garantindo a saúde financeira da loja;
  • Controlar o estoque, mantendo a organização de produtos, evitando faltas ou excessos, garantindo que esteja sempre atualizado, ajudando a manter o bom funcionamento da loja;
  • Auxiliar na operação de loja através das rotinas operacionais, como atendimento ao cliente, organização, reposição e suporte ao caixa;
  • Planejar as estratégias de venda desenvolvendo ações com base em análises de mercado, sazonalidade e comportamento do cliente, buscando resultados positivos e aumento da competitividade da loja;
  • Conduzir o processo de recrutamento e seleção para cargos operacionais de loja, garantindo o alinhamento entre o perfil buscado e os valores da cia;
  • Garantir o cuidado e conservação do patrimônio da cia, promovendo a conservação dos equipamentos e recursos para a segurança do ambiente de trabalho.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Graduação Completa;
  • Conhecimento do pacote office;
  • Habilidade analítica e estratégica;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Perfil direcionado a resultados;
  • Senso de urgência.

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Excel intermediário;
  • Experiência em liderança de equipes.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:

  • Regime CLT e benefícios abrangentes, como Vale Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco e Plano Odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub, promovendo bem-estar e qualidade de vida;
  • Seguro de vida, garantindo proteção para você e sua família;
  • Licenças estendidas: Somos uma Empresa Cidadã, com 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias de licença paternidade. Um tempo a mais para cuidar de quem mais importa - nosso futuro;
  • Descontos exclusivos nas nossas lojas físicas após o período de experiência, conectando você ainda mais aos nossos produtos e serviços;
  • Plataforma interna repleta de cursos e treinamentos que impulsionam sua trajetória profissional;
  • Ambiente colaborativo e inclusivo, perfeito para ensinar, aprender e se desenvolver tanto pessoal quanto profissionalmente.

Nosso impacto vai além:

Cada dia na Americanas é uma oportunidade de transformar desafios em soluções; ideias em realizações. Estamos comprometidos em fazer a diferença, cuidando das nossas pessoas e contribuindo para um impacto positivo não só para os nossos stakeholders, mas para toda a sociedade.

Se você quer fazer parte de uma empresa que valoriza a autenticidade, a inovação e o trabalho coletivo, venha fazer parte da Americanas S.A. Aqui, crescemos juntos, resolvemos a vida de milhões e criamos histórias que inspiram.

Local de Trabalho:

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Tangará da Serra/MT.

Etapas do processo

  • Cadastro
  • Entrevista com área de Gente
  • Entrevista com Gestão
  • Proposta
  • Contratação

Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 96 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.400 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

title: Representante de visita médica (BR)
description:
A Caudalie é uma marca francesa de skincare, criada por Mathilde e Bertrand Thomas em Bordeaux, em 1995. Nossos produtos são desenvolvidos com ingredientes naturais provenientes da vinha e da uva, unindo eficácia, inovação e compromisso com o meio ambiente.

No Brasil, estamos fortalecendo nossa presença junto à comunidade médica e buscamos um(a) Representante de Visita Médica para se juntar ao nosso time.

SUA MISSÃO

Desenvolver relações de longo prazo com dermatologistas e profissionais de medicina estética, levando a ciência da Caudalie à comunidade médica e contribuindo para ampliar o conhecimento, a recomendação e a prescrição da marca.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Desenvolver a marca em sua região por meio de visitas médicas regulares e estratégicas;
  • Apresentar à comunidade médica a ciência por trás da Caudalie, seus ativos, fórmulas, estudos e evidências de eficácia;
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos com profissionais de saúde, identificando necessidades e oportunidades de desenvolvimento;
  • Ser o elo entre a comunidade médica e a Caudalie, garantindo o reporte das visitas, feedbacks médicos e informações de farmacovigilância;
  • Participar de eventos científicos, congressos e workshops, com foco na geração de relacionamento, visibilidade da marca e ampliação da prescrição médica.
  • Desenvolver planos de ação por especialista e apresentar lançamentos e novidades;
  • Tornar-se um(a) especialista Caudalie, garantindo uma comunicação técnica, ética e consultiva.

O PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em visita médica, preferencialmente com dermatologistas e profissionais de medicina estética;
  • Rede de relacionamento sólida na área de dermatologia;
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de relacionamento;
  • Perfil dinâmico, organizado, curioso, colaborativo e orientado a resultados;
  • Experiência em congressos e eventos científicos será considerada um diferencial;
  • CNH válida e disponibilidade para viagens.

O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Pacote de remuneração e benefícios compatível com o mercado.

Se você se identifica com a Caudalie e quer fazer parte desse próximo capítulo da nossa história no Brasil, queremos conhecer você.

title: Analista de Recrutamento & Seleção Jr. - Operações (Rolândia - PR)
description:
Na Dori | Ferrara, Ferrero, Fox's Burton's Companies e The Fine Biscuits Company, somos reconhecidos e amados por pessoas de todas as gerações pela alegria que compartilhamos com elas – uma alegria feita pelas nossas pessoas. Junte-se a nós e descubra um mundo cheio de possibilidades, onde sua paixão encontrará o seu lugar.

A Dori | Ferrara é uma das maiores empresas de doces e snacks do Brasil! Há mais de seis décadas, com um time de mais de 3000 colaboradores, produzimos produtos que acompanham gerações e fazem parte da história e das lembranças de milhões de famílias, com marcas icônicas como Gomets®, Yogurte 100®, Pettiz® e Disqueti®.

Em 2023, iniciamos um novo capítulo ao nos tornarmos parte da Ferrara Candy Company, líder número 1 em balas e gomas nos Estados Unidos, com marcas mundialmente conhecidas como NERDS®, Brach's®, Jelly Belly®, SweeTARTS®, Laffy Taffy®, and Trolli®. E, na França, a Carambar & Co conquistou gerações de clientes fiéis graças ao apelo atemporal de marcas icônicas de doces e chocolates, como Carambar, Lutti, Krema, Poulain, Vichy e Terry's.

Com essa união, somos mais de 9.000 colaboradores e uma rede com mais de 30 unidades, garantindo nossa presença global.

Sobre a vaga

Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção será responsável por apoiar e executar os processos de Recrutamento & Seleção das unidades fabris, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e aderência dos candidatos ao perfil das posições e à cultura da companhia. Atuar em parceria com gestores e áreas de Recursos Humanos das unidades, contribuindo para o atendimento das necessidades de contratação da operação e para uma experiência positiva dos candidatos ao longo do processo seletivo.

Localidade: Rolândia - PR

Reporta a: Gerente de Talent e Performance

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial

Contamos com você para:

  • Conduzir processos de Recrutamento & Seleção para posições operacionais, técnicas e administrativas das unidades fabris, seguindo as políticas, procedimentos e SLAs estabelecidos pela área.
  • Realizar alinhamento de perfil das vagas com gestores e/ou RH das unidades, compreendendo requisitos técnicos, comportamentais e necessidades específicas da operação.
  • Divulgar oportunidades nos canais de recrutamento definidos pela companhia, buscando ampliar a atração de candidatos aderentes às posições.
  • Realizar triagem de currículos, entrevistas por competências e demais etapas previstas no processo seletivo.
  • Apoiar e conduzir processos seletivos de maior volume, especialmente para posições operacionais das fábricas.
  • Realizar busca ativa de candidatos e apoiar a construção de bancos de talentos para posições recorrentes e/ou críticas das unidades.
  • Manter contato próximo com candidatos durante todo o processo, garantindo comunicação adequada sobre etapas, prazos e devolutivas.
  • Acompanhar os processos desde a abertura da vaga até a aprovação do candidato e encaminhamento para admissão.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de recrutamento local, como feiras de empregabilidade, parcerias com instituições de ensino, entidades locais, comunidades e outros canais de atração.
  • Contribuir para ações de fortalecimento da marca empregadora nas regiões onde estão localizadas as unidades fabris.
  • Acompanhar indicadores básicos de R&S, como volume de vagas, tempo de fechamento, candidatos por vaga, fontes de recrutamento e status dos processos.
  • Atuar de forma integrada na condução do processo de integração.

Do que você precisa para fazer a diferença:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Psicologia, Administração, Gestão de Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Vivência com recrutamento de alto volume para posições operacionais e industriais.
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes industriais, manufatura, logística ou centros de distribuição.

O que nós oferecemos:

Na Dori | Ferrara, nos orgulhamos de prover aos nossos colaboradores:

  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR)
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Dr Dori (telemedicina)
  • Seguro de vida
  • Totalpass e/ou Wellhub
  • Refeitório no local
  • Cesta de Alimentos
  • Cesta de Natal
  • Vale transporte
  • Descontos em produtos

Igualdade de Oportunidades

Temos orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e progressão de carreira. Para isso, as decisões e oportunidades de emprego na Dori | Ferrara serão baseadas no mérito, nas qualificações e nas habilidades, independentemente da raça, cor, credo, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade e expressão de gênero, estado civil ou união civil, nacionalidade, ascendência, cidadania, idade, condição de militar ou veterano, deficiência, informações genéticas, gravidez (parto ou condição médica relacionada) ou qualquer outra base proibida por lei.

A Dori | Ferrara não realiza cobranças para a participação de processos seletivos e toda a nossa comunicação é feita através dos canais oficiais da empresa. Se receber qualquer mensagem solicitando pagamento ou dados de cartão de crédito, pedimos que não responda e entre em contato imediatamente com nossos canais oficiais de atendimento (redes sociais ou SAC ).

Em conformidade com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), informamos que todos os dados pessoais fornecidos durante o processo seletivo serão utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento e seleção. As informações serão tratadas com confidencialidade, segurança e armazenadas apenas pelo período necessário para o processo, sendo posteriormente descartadas de forma segura.

  • Nível de experiência

  • Setor

  • Tipo de emprego
  • Tempo integral

  • Agilidade

  • Melhoria contínua
  • Recursos jurídicos
  • Entrevistas

title: Closer de Vendas (Marketing)
description:
**Closer de Vendas High Ticket — B2B Jurídico (Fixo + Comissão)**

**Sobre a Mega Ads**

A Mega Ads é uma aceleradora de escritórios de advocacia. Há 7 anos trabalhamos só com o jurídico: mais de 3.000 escritórios atendidos e mais de R$7 milhões investidos em anúncios. Montamos para o advogado uma máquina completa de captação de clientes (marketing, pré-vendas, fechamento, CRM e ferramentas) que entrega o cliente final com contrato e procuração já assinados.

**A vaga**

Estamos abrindo 4 vagas de Closer. Aqui você não prospecta: as reuniões chegam agendadas e confirmadas pelo nosso time de pré-vendas. Seu trabalho é entrar na videochamada com o advogado dono do escritório, entender o negócio dele, apresentar a solução e fechar.

É uma vaga exigente, com volume alto de reuniões, produto complexo e meta clara. Em troca, você tem segurança no começo e ganho sem teto quando entrega.

**O que você vai fazer**

  • **Track Estrela:** com 3 meses seguidos acima de R$130 mil, você pode migrar para 11% sobre todo o faturamento, sem teto
  • Metas mínimas claras e progressivas: R$20 mil no primeiro mês, R$40 mil no segundo e R$50 mil/mês a partir do terceiro. Quem não bate a meta do primeiro mês não segue no time

**Requisitos**

  • Pelo menos 1 ano fechando vendas em reunião ou videochamada (closer, executivo de contas, consultor comercial, account executive)
  • Experiência com venda consultiva de ticket médio ou alto (B2B, serviços, mentoria, SaaS, high ticket)

  • Uso de Pipedrive ou outro CRM e de gravação de calls

**O que você recebe**

  • Produto validado em mais de 3.000 escritórios e uma operação de marketing de mais de R$7 milhões rodando por trás de cada reunião
  • Fixo que garante o começo e comissão sem teto para quem entrega

**Como é o processo**

title: Video Editor
description:
Our client in the retail health and personal care industry is hiring a Video Editor!

The Role

We're looking for an editor who didn't learn craft from brand commercials. You learned it from cutting affiliate offers where every second either holds attention or loses the click. You know how to build hooks, pattern interrupts, and pacing that survives the Meta scroll, and you're not precious about "clean" edits if aggressive wins.

What You'll Do

  • Edit high volume, direct response style video ads (UGC, VSLs, advertorial style video, native "ripped content" style creative) for Meta
  • Build multiple hook variations per concept to feed rapid creative testing
  • Work from raw UGC/creator footage, stock/found footage, and AI generated assets to assemble scroll stopping ads
  • Apply aggressive DR editing techniques: pattern interrupts, text overlays, captions, retention hooks, fake native/organic styling, before/after framing, etc.
  • Iterate fast on winning ads with new hooks, intros, and re cuts based on performance data from media buyers
  • Maintain a high weekly output volume without sacrificing hook quality
  • Collaborate directly with media buyers/creative strategists on what's working and what needs to change

Must Haves

  • Background editing for affiliate/performance marketing offers, not brand or corporate video. Comfortable with "blackhat"/aggressive angle offers (biohacks, before/afters, urgency driven claims, native/organic style ads that don't look like ads)
  • Strong grasp of what makes a video stop the scroll and hold watch time on Meta specifically
  • Proficiency in Premiere Pro, CapCut, and/or DaVinci Resolve
  • High output capacity, comfortable delivering multiple variants per day/week, not one polished video per month
  • Portfolio or reel showing performance style, not portfolio style, editing

Nice to Haves

  • Experience editing for health/wellness/nutra offers
  • Basic AI tool fluency (voice cloning, AI avatars, auto captioning, generative b roll) to speed up production
  • Copywriting instincts, you can suggest hook lines, not just execute someone else's script

title: International Channel Account Manager - Healthcare & Medical Technology
description:
Brazil, South America | Full-Time | Permanent | International Channel Sales & Distribution

Placed by Hotsourced – connecting top global talent with world-class international companies.

About the Role

We are looking for a commercially driven and experienced International Account Manager to take ownership of an international territory and portfolio of distributor partners.

You will work closely with distributors to develop territory plans, deliver sales targets, expand market penetration, launch products, identify new opportunities, and strengthen the organisation's presence across international markets.

This is a consultative, relationship-led sales role requiring someone who can operate confidently across different cultures, markets, and levels of seniority.

You will be expected to understand market dynamics, identify commercial opportunities, analyse competitor activity, forecast sales accurately, and translate strategy into measurable revenue growth. The role involves approximately 40% international travel, including the potential for 2–3 weeks away from home at a time, depending on business requirements.

If you are an experienced international sales professional who enjoys developing markets, working through distribution partners, and delivering measurable commercial results, this is an opportunity to take ownership of a significant international territory within a growing global healthcare business.

Responsibilities – What you'll be doing

  • Managing a portfolio of international distributor and channel partners across Brazil and assigned South American markets.
  • Developing and executing distributor and country-level business plans to achieve agreed sales targets.
  • Taking ownership of assigned territories and identifying opportunities for revenue growth and increased market penetration.
  • Delivering monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, and annual sales targets.
  • Building strong, commercially focused relationships with distributors, healthcare customers, clinicians, educators, and key stakeholders.
  • Supporting distributors to increase product penetration, customer reach, and market share.
  • Developing smaller accounts and resellers into stronger, higher-value distribution partners.
  • Identifying, recruiting, and onboarding new distributors across assigned territories.
  • Supporting new product launches and market-entry strategies.
  • Developing annual territory plans based on market trends, healthcare developments, customer needs, and commercial opportunities.
  • Monitoring competitor activity, pricing, market positioning, and emerging trends.
  • Providing accurate and timely sales forecasts to support business planning.
  • Monitoring distributor performance against agreed KPIs, budgets, and revenue targets.
  • Identifying commercial risks and opportunities and taking appropriate corrective action.
  • Providing product training and commercial guidance to distributor sales teams.
  • Sharing sales best practice and international market knowledge with distribution partners.
  • Supporting distributors with sales collateral, product positioning, marketing campaigns, and product launches.
  • Representing the organization at international conferences, exhibitions, and industry events.
  • Ensuring products are accurately positioned and represented across distributor websites and sales channels.
  • Maintaining accurate commercial information, sales data, forecasts, and account records using CRM and relevant business systems.

Requirements – What we're looking for

Essential

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in international channel sales, distributor management, or partner sales.
  • Proven experience independently managing an international region or territory.
  • Demonstrable track record of achieving sales targets and delivering measurable revenue growth.
  • Strong experience working with distributors, channel partners, or reseller networks.
  • Experience developing new markets and launching products within international territories.
  • Strong commercial planning, sales forecasting, and territory management skills.
  • Comfortable working with sales budgets, targets, KPIs, and commercial data.
  • Strong competitor analysis and market intelligence capability.
  • Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to present confidently to audiences ranging from C-suite executives to sales teams and end users.
  • Excellent written and spoken Portuguese, Spanish, English,
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of a territory.
  • Willingness and ability to undertake significant international travel, approximately 40% of working time.
  • Comfortable being away from home for extended international trips, potentially 2–3 weeks at a time.

Desirable

Experience within one or more of the following sectors:

  • Medical Technology / MedTech
  • Medical Devices
  • Healthcare Technology
  • Medical Equipment
  • Medical Simulation
  • Clinical Skills Training
  • Life Sciences
  • Diagnostics
  • Laboratory Equipment
  • Healthcare Education Technology
  • Working within a start-up, scale-up, or entrepreneurial environment.
  • Salesforce or another CRM system.
  • Developing distributor sales teams through product and commercial training.
  • Transitioning reseller relationships into formal distributor partnerships.
  • Working across emerging and established international markets.

Language Requirements (non negotiable)

  • 1st price Fluent Portuguese
  • Fluent business level Spanish is essential
  • Fluent business-level English is essential.

Education & Qualifications

  • Degree-level qualification preferred.
  • A qualification or professional background in Nursing, Medicine, Healthcare, Life Sciences, or a related field would be advantageous.
  • Equivalent commercial experience will also be considered.

The Profile We're Looking For

  • Mature, experienced, and commercially confident.
  • Comfortable owning and managing an international region.
  • An experienced international traveller with strong exposure to different markets and cultures.
  • Highly capable of building and maintaining distributor relationships.
  • Commercially analytical and comfortable working with numbers, targets, budgets, and forecasts.
  • A fast learner who can quickly understand new products, markets, customers, and competitive environments.
  • Confident working autonomously while knowing when to escalate issues.
  • Professional and articulate, with strong presentation and communication skills.
  • Highly organized with excellent time-management skills.
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-moving international environment.

Work Schedule

  • This is a full-time, permanent position based in Brazil.
  • The role requires flexibility to accommodate different international markets, customers, distributors, and time zones.
  • International travel will form a significant part of the position, at approximately 40% of working time.
  • Travel may include extended international trips of 2–3 weeks at a time, as well as conferences, exhibitions, distributor meetings, product launches, and customer visits.

Pay & Benefits – What we offer

  • Very Competitive salary package.
  • Full-time, permanent opportunity based in Brazil.
  • Opportunity to work with a growing international healthcare and medical technology business.
  • Significant ownership of an international territory and distributor portfolio.
  • Exposure to global healthcare markets, clinicians, educators, and international commercial partners.
  • International travel and participation in industry conferences and events.
  • Opportunity to contribute directly to international market expansion and revenue growth.
  • Career development within a growing global commercial team.
  • Collaborative and commercially focused international working environment.

What Success Looks Like

  • International sales targets are consistently achieved.
  • Distributor revenue and performance continue to grow.
  • New distributors are successfully identified, onboarded, and developed.
  • Existing distributor relationships become stronger and more commercially productive.
  • New markets and product opportunities are identified and developed.
  • Sales forecasts are accurate, timely, and commercially meaningful.
  • Territory plans translate into measurable revenue and market growth.
  • Competitor and market intelligence is actively used to identify opportunities and risks.
  • Distributor sales teams are well trained and equipped to represent the product portfolio.
  • CRM, pipeline, forecasting, and account information remain accurate and up to date.

Reality Check

  • This is not a traditional desk-based Account Manager role.
  • You will be responsible for managing an international territory, working through distributors, developing markets, delivering sales targets, and representing the business across different countries and cultures.
  • The role requires someone who is comfortable with commercial accountability, frequent international travel, independent decision-making, and working across multiple markets simultaneously.
  • There will be periods where you may be away from home for several weeks, and flexibility around international travel, customer requirements, conferences, and business events is essential.
  • You will need to be commercially curious, highly organized, culturally adaptable, and confident enough to build relationships with stakeholders at every level.
  • If you have a proven track record in international channel sales, distributor management, territory growth, and new market development, and you're ready to take ownership of a global commercial portfolio, this could be an excellent opportunity to take your international sales career to the next level.

Hit Apply and take the next step in your international sales career.

title: Key Account Sales Director
description:
JD Industrials | Director of Key Account Sales, Brazil

Work Location: Brazil (based in São Paulo, regular nationwide business travel)

Reporting to: Latin America Regional Lead

1. Business Overview

  • JD Industrials is the B2B industrial supply chain division of JD Group. We deliver one-stop digital procurement solutions covering MRO spare parts, industrial consumables, electrical automation, tools & security equipment, production materials and other industrial goods, and implement an accompanying global expansion strategy.
  • As Latin America's largest industrial market, Brazil hosts numerous Chinese enterprises expanding overseas in new energy vehicles, construction machinery, infrastructure engineering, mining and manufacturing, alongside major local industrial conglomerates. JD Industrials has established a local legal entity in Brazil. Leveraging cross-border supply chains, local warehousing & distribution, customs clearance fulfillment and digital procurement platform capabilities, we serve Chinese-owned factories operating in Brazil and leading local industrial clients.
  • As the lead for key account sales in Brazil, this role takes charge of local KA client acquisition, commercial negotiations and long-term account management, builds the key account sales system, and drives sustained revenue growth of industrial goods business in Brazil.

2. Job Responsibilities

  • Key Account Development & Target Delivery

Take overall ownership of acquiring Chinese overseas enterprises and large local KA clients across manufacturing, infrastructure, energy and mining sectors in Brazil. Formulate key account sales strategies and annual business plans, deliver revenue, gross profit and collection targets assigned by headquarters, and secure long-term framework bulk procurement agreements. Independently engage client procurement directors, supply chain leaders and factory management teams; oversee the full lifecycle of business opportunities, tendering, commercial negotiations and contract signing.

  • In-depth Account Management & Demand Mining

Identify procurement pain points at client factories. Combine JD Industrials' supply chain strengths to deliver customized solutions including MRO consolidated procurement, hybrid cross-border & local fulfillment, and digital procurement services. Continuously increase wallet share among existing clients, tap incremental opportunities across multiple production sites and subsidiaries, and foster long-term strategic partnerships.

  • Local Market & Competition Analysis

Continuously research Brazil's industrial goods market regulations, major competitors, pricing frameworks of local suppliers, industry policies and import customs requirements. Produce periodic market analysis reports, feed client demands and category opportunities back to the regional headquarters, and support optimization of localized product assortments and fulfillment solutions for Brazil.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration & Project Execution

Coordinate with local Brazil teams covering operations, supply chain, customs and finance, as well as procurement & sales teams at China headquarters. Manage end-to-end order fulfillment, delivery tracking, invoicing & payment collection, and after-sales issue resolution. Control client receivables risks to maintain healthy cash flow.

Sales Team Building & Management (0-to-1 Local Team Establishment)

Build a local Brazilian key account sales talent pipeline aligned with business progress. Set individual KPIs and performance appraisal mechanisms. Equip the team with capabilities for business development and solution-based industrial sales, and coordinate joint efforts to deliver priority projects.

  • Ecosystem Partner Development

Engage local industry associations, channel partners and logistics service providers appropriately to expand lead sources and cultivate a sound local business ecosystem.

3. Job Requirements

  • Education & Language

Bachelor's degree or above; fluent Portuguese (mandatory for commercial negotiations); English as working auxiliary language. Proficiency in Chinese is preferred (significant advantage for engaging Chinese enterprises).

Industry Experience (Mandatory)

Minimum 8 years of B2B industrial goods key account sales or sales management experience, with deep expertise in MRO, industrial spare parts, electrical equipment, tools, security products, automation and engineering materials. Familiar with industrial bulk procurement models and factory procurement decision-making chains.

Hands-on experience operating in the Brazilian market and existing client resources in manufacturing, new energy, infrastructure and mining sectors are preferred. Prior experience serving Chinese enterprises expanding overseas is a plus.

  • Core Competencies

Proven track record of 0-to-1 overseas market development. Expertise in annual bulk procurement negotiations and framework agreement management for large conglomerates. Basic understanding of cross-border industrial trade, import customs clearance and localized fulfillment. Result-oriented mindset with strong awareness of receivables risk control.

Capable of independently managing client projects with annual transaction volumes ranging from millions to tens of millions. Adept at solution-based sales instead of pure product trading.

  • Work Location Adaptability

Long-term assignment in Brazil; able to undertake frequent inter-city business travel within Brazil. Familiar with Brazilian business culture, labor laws and trade regulations. Comfortable with cross-time-zone collaboration with China headquarters.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working experience with Schneider Electric, 3M, Grainger, RS Components, MISUMI, major local industrial distributors or cross-border industrial supply chain companies;
  • Understanding of industrial e-commerce and digital procurement platform business models;
  • Established senior-level connections with Chinese-owned factories or local industrial conglomerates in Brazil.

title: Data Engineer - Financial Data Pipelines (Contract)
description:
Senior Data Engineer — Financial Services — Contract (Remote, Brazil)

Santiago Consult is a UK-based data and AI consultancy. We build data platforms, pipelines and AI systems for clients across the UK and Europe, and we're expanding our delivery capability in Brazil.

We're building a network of senior contract data engineers with financial services experience, ready to bring onto client projects as they start. This is a talent pool ahead of upcoming engagements, so we want to talk to strong people now even if a project isn't live on day one.

The work

Financial data is unforgiving. Reconciliation has to balance, lineage has to be traceable, and "roughly right" isn't a thing. You'd be working directly with the founder on client delivery — building production pipelines where correctness and auditability matter as much as throughput.

Typical engagements involve:

  • Designing and building ETL/ELT pipelines for transactional and financial data
  • Data modelling and transformation in dbt
  • Warehouse architecture in BigQuery or Snowflake
  • Integrating banking, payments, ledger or market data sources
  • Reconciliation logic, data quality frameworks and testing
  • Building for auditability, lineage and regulatory reporting
  • Working to a clear technical standard, with architecture and code review from our side

What we're looking for

  • Production data engineering experience in financial services, banking, fintech, payments or insurance
  • Strong SQL — performance tuning, window functions, complex transformations
  • Strong Python for data engineering
  • Solid production experience with BigQuery or Snowflake
  • dbt in a real production environment
  • Git and a proper branching/review workflow
  • Experience with data that has to reconcile, and where mistakes have consequences
  • Comfortable working in English with UK-based clients
  • Cloud platform experience — GCP or AWS

Nice to have

  • Regulatory reporting experience
  • Airflow or similar orchestration
  • Terraform / infrastructure as code
  • Streaming or real-time data (payments, fraud, transaction monitoring)
  • Data governance or lineage tooling
  • Exposure to UK or European financial regulation

Practical details

  • Fully remote, contract basis (PJ)
  • Project-based work, typically several weeks to several months
  • Good overlap with UK hours (Brazil is 3–4 hours behind, so the working day lines up well)
  • Paid in GBP or BRL, your preference

How to apply

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile, and please include:

  • Your day rate expectation (BRL or GBP — whichever you work in) — applications without a daily rate expectation won't be considered
  • A short note on one financial-data pipeline you've built: the stack, the scale, and what made it hard
  • Your availability and current commitments
  • Whether you invoice as PJ

We read everything and reply either way.

title: Coordenador de Crédito e Cobrança
description:
A AutoZone é uma empresa americana e multinacional, listada na Bolsa de Valores de Nova York, reconhecida como a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo. Atualmente, possui mais de 7.000 lojas distribuídas pelos Estados Unidos, Porto Rico, México e Brasil, com o apoio de mais de 100.000 AutoZoners em quatro continentes.

No Brasil, a companhia mantém um ritmo acelerado de crescimento, com mais de 158 lojas em sete estados — São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás — além de um escritório corporativo em São Paulo, localizado na Vila Leopoldina. Em 2025, foi inaugurado o Centro de Distribuição próprio em Paulínia/SP, fortalecendo a estrutura logística e sustentando a estratégia de expansão no país.

A AutoZone tem como princípios a mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e o compromisso de ir além. Fazer parte da empresa significa integrar uma equipe que valoriza dedicação, trabalho em equipe e desenvolvimento profissional, oferecendo suporte e ferramentas para o crescimento e construção de carreira dos AutoZoners.

Descrição do Cargo

Responsável por coordenar as atividades de análise de crédito, faturamento e cobrança, garantindo a eficiência dos processos, a mitigação de riscos e o cumprimento dos prazos e políticas internas. Atua de forma estratégica na gestão da carteira de clientes, apoiando o negócio na tomada de decisão e assegurando a saúde financeira das operações.

Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de crédito: Coordenar a análise e concessão de crédito, garantindo aderência às políticas internas e adequada avaliação de risco, com base em relatórios financeiros, histórico de pagamento e informações de mercado.
  • Gestão da cobrança: Liderar as estratégias de cobrança, acompanhando indicadores de inadimplência, definindo ações para recuperação de crédito e conduzindo negociações em casos mais críticos.
  • Gestão de equipe: Liderar, desenvolver e acompanhar a equipe, promovendo alinhamento de metas, capacitação e melhoria contínua dos processos da área.
  • Controle e governança: Assegurar a acuracidade dos registros de contas a receber, bem como a conformidade com os controles internos, políticas corporativas e exigências de auditoria.
  • Indicadores e performance: Monitorar KPIs da área, elaborando relatórios gerenciais e propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Interface com áreas internas: Atuar de forma próxima às áreas comerciais, operações (lojas), financeiras e demais stakeholders, garantindo alinhamento estratégico e suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Melhoria de processos: Identificar oportunidades de otimização e automação dos processos de crédito e cobrança, promovendo eficiência e redução de riscos.

Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo (Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas).
  • Vivência na área de crédito ou cobrança.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Diferencial: Conhecimento com ERP SAP ou TOTVS Protheus.

Informações Adicionais

  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.
  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido, com atuação na região da Vila Leopoldina.
  • Benefícios oferecidos: assistência médica, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio com academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e 20% de desconto em produtos nas lojas AutoZone.

Valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.

title: Ombudsman / Ouvidor
description:
About VelaFi

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.

Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.

Position Overview

VelaFi Brazil is looking for a qualified Ombudsman (Ouvidor) to manage the mandatory Ouvidoria structure for our regulated VASP entity under Resolution BCB No. 552/2025, Resolution BCB No. 28/2021, and CMN Resolution No. 4,860/2020.

Serving as the second-instance escalation mechanism, the Ombudsman acts independently from operational and sales teams, championing client rights and reporting systemic insights directly to top management.

Location

Hybrid: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Second-Instance Complaints: Receive, register, and resolve complex client complaints escalated from standard customer service (SAC) within mandatory BCB resolution timeframes.
  • Independent Mediation: Act as an impartial mediator between clients and internal operational units.
  • Root-Cause Analysis: Identify recurring operational failures or systemic compliance risks and recommend corrective action plans to executive leadership.
  • BCB & Board Reporting: Prepare periodic Ombudsman reports (Relatório de Ouvidoria) detailing complaint volume, resolution metrics, and root cause analyses for internal governance and BCB regulatory filings.

Qualifications

  • Experience: Proven background in Client Advocacy, Ombudsman (Ouvidoria), Legal, or Regulatory Compliance within BCB-regulated financial institutions, payments, or crypto platforms.
  • Consumer Law: Solid working knowledge of the Brazilian Consumer Defense Code (Código de Defesa do Consumidor - CDC) and BCB Ouvidoria regulations.
  • Certifications: Active Ombudsman Certification (Certificação de Ouvidoria by Anbima, Febraban, or Abecip), required.
  • Languages: Fluent Portuguese (mandatory) and professional working English (preferred).

Desired Competencies

  • Regulatory Compliance & Dispute Resolution: Deep understanding of BCB consumer protection frameworks, Resolution BCB 28/2021, CMN 4,860/2020, and the Brazilian Consumer Defense Code (CDC).
  • Executive Presence: Ability to act as an autonomous authority, presenting independent semi-annual Ombudsman reports (Relatórios de Ouvidoria) to the Board of Directors and BCB examiners.
  • Strong Analytical & Root-Cause Analysis Skills: Capability to analyze complaint data, identify recurring product/operational bottlenecks, and drive structural recommendations.
  • High Accountability & Ownership: Strong commitment to meeting strict regulatory response deadlines (BCB SLA requirements) and managing regulatory exposure.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Mediation: Proven ability to liaise neutrally between aggrieved customers, internal business lines, Legal, Compliance, and Operations teams.
  • Ability to build scalable dispute resolution infrastructure: Capacity to design and scale second-instance ticketing systems, automated SLA tracking, and complaint reporting workflows tailored for fast-growing financial platforms.

Nice to Have

  • Fintech & Cross-Border Experience: Background handling complex customer grievances related to international wire transfers, eFX exchange rates, Pix transactions, or digital asset settlements.
  • BACEN Reporting Exposure: Prior experience inputting data into or submitting regulatory complaint reports through official BCB reporting portals (Unifoco/RDR).
  • Legal/Regulatory Background: Formal education or background in Legal, Consumer Law, or Compliance within regulated financial institutions (IPs/SDFs/VASPs) in Brasil.

Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.
  • Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent.
  • Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions.
  • Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities.

Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Coordenador de FP&A
description:
O DESAFIO

Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de FP&A para atuar de forma estratégica na estrutura de finanças de uma multinacional de grande porte. Esta posição é peça-chave no suporte consultivo às frentes comerciais e corporativas, atuando diretamente como parceiro de negócio para impulsionar a governança, a melhoria contínua de processos e apoiar a liderança executiva em tomadas de decisões de alto impacto.

PILARES DE ATUAÇÃO:

  • Análise de resultado: Responsável pelo reporte mensal e análise das variações real x orçado, com foco em rentabilidade (volume, preço, mix, canal, FX rate, custo), controle de despesas, Capex e demais KPIs de acompanhamento de performance.
  • Elaboração de Budget/ Forecast: Responsável pela coordenação do plano anual, e revisões mensais e trimestrais da Empresa para elaboração de P&L e indicadores de balanço.
  • Suporte a Marketing & Vendas: avaliação de propostas comerciais, análise de variação de margem dos produtos, campanhas de Marketing, análise de investimento, margem de novos produtos, rentabilidade mensal por marca, categoria, canal.
  • Controle de despesas: análise de despesas real x orçado, por centro de custo, tipo de despesa. Atuação junto aos gestores para garantir execução dentro das estimativas.
  • Gestão de BI e Dashboards: responsável pela gestão dos diversos reportes da área, local e regional, BI interno com KPIs mensais de monitoramento de performance e apresentações executivas. Identificar oportunidades de automação e melhoria de processos/ atividades da área. Conduzir a área para perfil analítico/ estratégico vs operacional/ executor.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
When you join GAR, you join something bigger. Big in scale, big in opportunities to grow, and big in impact. With over 100,000 employees across 14 countries, spanning Asia, Europe, North America, and South America, Golden Agri-Resources (GAR) is one of the largest agribusinesses in the world. We manage over half a million hectares of palm oil plantations, including smallholder farms, across Indonesia. But our size is only part of the story.

Since 1997, we've put sustainability at the centre of how we grow, working hand-in-hand with farmers, communities, and partners to deliver food, fuel, and a better future. We're a seed-to-shelf business rooted in palm oil, now expanding across other essential crops like sugar, soybean, sunflower, and coconut. Our people are our edge. We invest in them through global opportunities, cross-border exposure, and continuous learning, because growing a better business starts with growing our people. Here, your career feeds something meaningful for the planet, people, and generations to come.

We're looking for a Senior Accountant to join our team in São Paulo, taking ownership of finance, accounting, tax, legal, IT and treasury — from financial statements and management reporting to budgeting and cash management. You'll work closely with our Trade, Logistics, Operations and Control teams in Brazil, and partner with the Finance Manager to help build systems, processes, and tax, legal and treasury structures from the ground up.

We're looking for someone who is a collaborative team player as well as an independent thinker, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a hands-on, proactive approach to improving processes. You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and bring innovative thinking that adds value across the organization.

Interested? Let's connect!

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate accounting records per local statutory requirements and group policies, and perform month-end/year-end closing, including journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, and schedules.
  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and resolve discrepancies promptly, and support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting packages.
  • Manage AR in collaboration with corporate and local teams, and handle payments and customer invoicing, including entering payment instructions and coordinating approvals for timely, accurate release.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls and accounting procedures, and support external and internal audits with documentation and explanations.
  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations and filing requirements, and prepare, review, and coordinate direct and indirect tax filings and payments on time.
  • Maintain accurate records for tax-related transactions and balances, and prepare tax reconciliations, provisions, and deferred tax calculations.
  • Coordinate with external tax advisors and support corporate income tax compliance, including transfer pricing, intercompany transactions, and related tax reporting.
  • Coordinate tax audits, inspections, and inquiries from authorities, and support electronic invoicing and digital tax compliance requirements.
  • Monitor tax legislation changes and assess business impact, while continuously improving tax processes, controls, and reporting efficiency.
  • Partner with Finance, Operations, HR, and external providers on financial and tax reporting, and support SAP-related finance and tax projects, testing, and improvements.
  • Contribute to automation, standardization, and continuous improvement across finance.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Finance / Accountancy / Tax
  • 3+ years' experience in finance and accounting department
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS and SAP.
  • Good working knowledge of direct and indirect taxation.
  • Experience in risk management including credit, market and foreign currency risk.
  • Experience with implementing IT systems.
  • Proficient with MS Office .
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • Experience of working in an international environment; experience working in a commodity trading company is preferred

We Offer

  • An entrepreneurial and international environment where developing opportunities for growth is valued
  • Training opportunities, locally and globally
  • Health insurance
  • Meal support (vale refeição)
  • Transport support/Parking lot (Vale transporte ou vaga de estacionamento)

Please submit your resume/CV in English.

Please note that we may incorporate an assessment and reference checks in our selection procedures.

title: Purchasing Specialist
description:
Purchasing Specialist - Supply Chain

The Purchasing Specialist, General position is responsible for supporting manufacturing plant

operations, ensuring compliance, operational efficiency, quality standards, and coordination

with cross-functional teams.

  • Manage daily operational activities related to purchase – general.
  • Build an inclusive environment in supplier relationship & drive to attain the company Goal.
  • Monitor Inventory management and ensure Inventory variance within limits including tracking Inventory Outstanding for Raw Materials
  • Liaise with cross-functional teams to comprehend and understand material specifications and requirements
  • Scrutinize and select the best vendors as per requirements and get inputs/ approval from the Head
  • Implement checks and tests to ensure that spares/ parts/ products meet required specifications in terms of quality, quantity and function
  • Proactively identify and troubleshoot issues thereby managing risks
  • Analyze MIS, dashboards and periodic reports, identify issues or areas of improvement and provide suggestions to senior management
  • Drive the implementation of innovative solutions to meet business requirements keeping track of future growth and requirements
  • Monitor material cost and identify areas to reduce costs.
  • Ensure Redressal of supplier issues & resolutions within agreed timelines
  • Develop strategies to improve Employee engagement Procurement survey score by providing employee training and exposure, workshops participation
  • Support Digitization, change management and continuous improvement initiatives by identifying operations which can be automated such as storage handling automation
  • Ensure adherence to sourcing and logistics / Procurement policies and procedures, external and internal audit compliances, Periodic Stock Verifications, and regulatory standards.

Qualifications/ Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree or technical qualification relevant to the role.
  • Minimum 5–8 years' experience in relevant field
  • Experience in manufacturing industry, preferably automotive or motorcycle sector.
  • Minimum 5–8 years' experience in relevant field

Royal Enfield - About Us:

The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield has created beautifully crafted motorcycles since 1901. From its British roots, a manufacturing plant was established in Madras in 1955, a foothold from which Royal Enfield spearheaded the growth of India's middleweight motorcycle segment. Royal Enfield is engaging, uncomplicated, accessible and fun to ride; a medium for exploration and self-expression. It's an approach to the brand called Pure Motorcycling.

Royal Enfield's premium motorcycle line-up caters to varied aspirations and motivations. From stylish retro and neo-retro roadsters like the Hunter 350, the Interceptor 650 and the Shotgun 650, to quintessentially thoroughbred cruisers like the Meteor 350, and the Super Meteor 650; and from adrenaline pumping machines like the all-new Himalayan 450 adventure tourer, the Scram 411 ADV crossover and the Continental GT 650 cafe racer, to the timeless and iconic classics, like the Bullet and the Classic 350; Royal Enfield has an enviable portfolio of motorcycles.

Riders and a passionate community are fostered with a rich profusion of events at a local, regional and international level. Most notable are Motoverse (previously Rider Mania), an annual gathering of thousands of Royal Enfield enthusiasts in Goa, and series of epic rides ranging from peaceful and picturesque to the treacherous and challenging that test the mettle of the rider and the machine, and at the same time deepen the bond between them.

A division of Eicher Motors Limited, Royal Enfield operates through more than 2000 stores across all major cities and towns in India and through nearly 1080 stores in more than 65 countries around the globe. Royal Enfield has two world-class Technology Centres, in Bruntingthorpe, UK, and in Chennai, India. The company's worldclass, state-of-the-art production facilities are located at Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal near Chennai, along with its legacy facility at Thiruvottiyur, which was Royal Enfield's first modern manufacturing facility in India, set-up in 1955. Royal Enfield also has modern CKD Assembly facilities across 5 global locations - Nepal, Brazil, Thailand, Argentina and Colombia.

Eicher Motors Limited (EML) (Bloomberg: EIM IN Reuters: EICH.NS) is the listed parent of Royal Enfield, global leader in the middleweight motorcycles segment (250cc - 750cc). For FY '24, Eicher Motors Ltd recorded a total income of INR 16,536 crores which is approximately USD 2.01 billion.

title: Retail Credit Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They're among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We're looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk
  • Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models
  • Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring
  • Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls
  • Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments
  • Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance
  • Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact
  • Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs
  • Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite
  • Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability

What you'll need

  • Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm
  • Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages
  • A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields
  • Fluency in English

Nice to have

  • Experience in the second line of defence (risk)
  • Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL

Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

  • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don't use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it's a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Us

At Seequent, we help organisations to understand the underground, giving the confidence to make better decisions faster.

We build world-leading technology that is at the forefront of Earth sciences, transforming the way our customers work. Every day we help them develop critical mineral resources more sustainably, design and build better infrastructure, source renewable energy, and reduce their impact on the environment.

We operate in 145+ countries while proudly maintaining headquarters in New Zealand.

The role

The Customer Success Manager plays a pivotal role in transforming customer sales into long-term success. Driven by a mantra of maximizing "users and usage," you will serve as the primary strategic liaison between assigned accounts and internal teams such as technical support, product management, and account management. By developing a deep understanding of customer businesses and workflows, you will ensure users transition smoothly into active advocates of our solutions. This role focuses on optimizing product value, building strong operational rhythms, and addressing complex challenges. Please note this is an office-based role requiring occasional travel to client sites, and it does not have direct reports.

In this role you will have the opportunity to:

  • Build strong, loyal relationships with key account stakeholders through a consistent interaction cadence, ensuring proactive support and a highly collaborative operating rhythm.
  • Assess client requirements and align them with internal technical experts to deliver targeted onboarding and training, actively following up to ensure realized value.
  • Track KPIs, NPS data, and usage metrics to proactively identify risks and opportunities, delivering meaningful insights and executive-level reporting to clients.
  • Partner closely with Strategic Account Managers to provide data-driven insights from account knowledge, identifying opportunities to expand the account with additional products or services.
  • Monitor customer engagement with technical support, liaising directly with internal domain specialists to address deep technical questions and resolve issues before they escalate.
  • Represent the voice of the customer at a strategic level within Seequent, ensuring their needs actively shape product development, onboarding approaches, and overall customer experience.

Essential Knowledge Skills And Experience

  • Bring 7+ years of relevant industry experience, providing the credibility required to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Maintain an empathetic, results-oriented approach heavily focused on understanding customer challenges, driving positive outcomes, and fostering long-term loyalty.
  • Possess wide technical proficiency across Seequent's portfolio (broad rather than deep), enabling you to connect different products and confidently frame solution pathways.
  • Demonstrate exceptional interpersonal and influencing skills, combined with high emotional intelligence, to build trust, navigate ambiguity, and strengthen complex organizational relationships.
  • Apply a strong ability to anticipate potential roadblocks, investigate issues thoroughly, and provide creative, effective solutions.
  • Utilize excellent organizational capabilities to manage competing priorities across a complex portfolio of major accounts while consistently driving project momentum.
  • Must have fluency in English and Portuguese.
  • Must be based in Belo Horizonte or be willing to relocate.

Our Commitment to Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion

At Seequent, we champion the uniqueness of each individual. Our commitment to inclusiveness, equity, and accessibility is fundamental to who we are. If you require accommodation during our recruitment process, please let our Talent Acquisition team know. We are here to ensure a fair opportunity for all.

Research underscores that some individuals, especially women and underrepresented groups, may hesitate to apply for roles if they don't meet every requirement. Please don't count yourself out if you don't tick every box. We are committed to hiring a diverse team and encourage individuals of all background and abilities to apply. Thank you for considering us as your potential employer; we're excited to see what you can bring to our team!

Benefits of being a Seequenteer and why you'll love being on our team.

Our people – Working at Seequent means becoming part of a community of collaborative innovators with insatiable curiosity and a passion to make a difference. Seequenteers are experts at what they do, visionaries with bold ideas for the future, and driven by a desire to make meaningful change.

Our culture – At Seequent you'll be encouraged to Find a Better Way, Think Customer, Collaborate Enthusiastically, Exceed Expectations and Take Ownership, no matter what role you're in. title: Practice Operations Specialist — Patient Access & Revenue Cycle
description:
Mental Health Mastery Group, LLC — U.S. telepsychiatry medical practice

100% home office from Brazil · Full-time · Independent contractor · Payment in USD

Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (10:00–19:00 Brasília), one hour for lunch.

Work directly with a U.S. medical practice, from home, in Brazil.

We are a physician-led American telepsychiatry practice serving patients across five U.S. states. We are hiring one person in Brazil to be our operational front line: the voice our patients hear when they call, and the person who deals directly with U.S. insurance companies, our billing partner, and our clinical team.

This is real responsibility inside an American healthcare business, not outsourced task work. You will learn the U.S. healthcare system from the inside — eligibility, benefits, prior authorizations, credentialing, revenue cycle — knowledge very few professionals in Brazil have.

Compensation is in USD and well above the local market for equivalent roles.

About us

Mental Health Mastery Group is a physician-led U.S. outpatient telepsychiatry practice serving patients in English, Portuguese, and Spanish. We are small, growing, and run on precision — every patient contact, eligibility check, and claim is visible to the Medical Director.

You will work directly with the Medical Director, alongside our Practice Operations Consultant/Manager, our U.S. billing partner, and our clinical team.

Core responsibilities — months 1 to

3The first three months are dedicated entirely to patient access and revenue cycle. We want this running cleanly before anything is added

.

Patient access — the foundation of the rol

e• Answer inbound patient calls live in English and Portuguese — 95% answer rate, under 3-minute average handle time. Expect 10-20 calls on a busy day

.• Respond to patient WhatsApp and email within 10 minutes during business hours

.• Schedule, confirm, reschedule, and manage cancellations in Tebra; track prescription-request alerts and flag patients who cancel without rebooking

.• Run insurance eligibility and benefits verification before every new patient visit, and stop visits that fail verification

.• Relay administrative and logistical information to patients on the provider's instruction. This role does not give clinical or medical advice — all clinical questions are routed to the treating provider

.

Revenue cycle and payer coordinatio

n• Call U.S. insurance payers (BCBS MA, Optum, Medicare, commercial plans) on defined questions and return written answers: representative name, reference number, and portal confirmation

.• Collect patient payments, post them accurately, and maintain the daily payment tracker

.• Coordinate with our billing partner on claim issues, denials, and patient balances

.• Support credentialing, enrollment, and payer-portal maintenance

.Operations and compliance suppor

t• Maintain accurate patient demographics, insurance records, and documentation in Tebra

.• Work within HIPAA-compliant systems (Microsoft 365 / Teams). All records and internal communication are in English

.• Deliver time-sensitive items on agreed deadlines and report status without being asked twice

.

Where this role grows — month 4 onwar

dMental Health Mastery Group is more than an outpatient practice. The Medical Director leads a forensic psychiatric expert witness practice, a consulting psychiatry line, and an expanding neuromodulation program covering TMS, ECT, and esketamine. All of it runs through MHMG, and all of it needs administrative execution

.Once patient access is running cleanly, this role takes on that work

:• Coordinating scheduling and correspondence with law firms, consulting clients, and vendor

s• Preparing and issuing invoices, tracking payments, and following up on outstanding receivable

s• Supporting coordination of the neuromodulation program as it develop

s• Keeping program documentation, agreements, and records current and organize

dThis is the part of the job that makes it a career rather than a desk. You will be inside the business side of a U.S. psychiatric practice as it builds new service lines

.

You are the right candidate i

f• You live in Brazi

l• Your English is at a professional working level (C1/C2) — written and spoken — and you are comfortable being on the phone with U.S. patients all da

y• You have a Bachelor's degree or highe

r• You have experience in healthcare administration, patient access, medical billing, or a healthcare call center — behavioral health is a strong plu

s• You can run administrative projects end to end — invoicing, vendor follow-up, receivables tracking — without someone checking whether you did i

t• You are comfortable with an EHR (Tebra/Kareo preferred), insurance eligibility portals, and a VoIP phone system (RingCentral preferred

)• You understand — or can quickly learn — U.S. insurance benefits, prior authorizations, copays, and deductible

s• You follow through without being reminded, document what happened, and escalate early when something will not be done on tim

e• You handle confidential information with absolute discretio

n• You work well independently in a fully remote environmen

t

Please read before applyin

gThis role is demanding and specific. Please do not apply if any of the following apply to you

:• You are not based in Brazil. This is a hard requirement with no exceptions

.• Your English is not at a professional working level (CEFR C1 or equivalent). You will speak with U.S. patients about appointments, insurance coverage, and account balances every day, and with U.S. insurance representatives on the practice's behalf. You must be understood clearly on the first pass, without the patient asking you to repeat yourself. Conversational or intermediate English is not sufficient

.• You do not hold a minimum of a Bachelor's degree

.• You do not have stable high-speed internet and a private, quiet workspace. You will be on calls all day

.• You are looking for back-office or project-only work. The telephone is the core of this position, and it remains so even as your responsibilities grow

.

If none of the above apply to you, we encourage you to apply

.

To appl

ySend your résumé in English, your desired monthly rate in USD, and a short note (5 sentences maximum) describing one time you fixed a broken process at a medical practice or service operation

.Qualified candidates will complete a live 15-minute telephone screen conducted entirely in English, plus a short scheduling and eligibility scenario exercise

.

Sobre a Habitus Investimentos.

A Habitus Investimentos é um escritório credenciado à XP Investimentos, com foco em relacionamento de longo prazo, gestão patrimonial responsável e desenvolvimento contínuo de pessoas. Acreditamos que resultados sustentáveis são consequência de equipes alinhadas, líderes preparados e uma cultura baseada em ética, confiança e protagonismo.

Nossa visão de liderança.

Na Habitus, liderar é assumir responsabilidade por pessoas, resultados e cultura.

Acreditamos em líderes que:

  • Desenvolvem pessoas, não apenas números.
  • Conhecem seu time individualmente.
  • Influenciam pelo exemplo.
  • Constroem confiança, respeito e engajamento genuíno.

A liderança não é um cargo, é um exercício contínuo de autoconhecimento, inteligência emocional, franqueza e coragem. Valorizamos líderes firmes, humanos e éticos, capazes de conduzir conversas difíceis com respeito e empatia.

Aqui, o líder é responsável pelo sucesso coletivo, sabe priorizar recursos, toma decisões complexas e inspira o time a crescer junto.

O Líder Comercial de Assessores de Investimentos será responsável por conduzir, desenvolver e potencializar a performance de uma equipe de assessores, alinhando estratégia comercial, cultura e resultados financeiros.

Atuará como elo entre a diretoria e o time, garantindo clareza de objetivos, execução com qualidade e evolução contínua dos profissionais.

Principais responsabilidades.

  • Compreender profundamente a missão, valores e objetivos estratégicos da Habitus.
  • Participar de reuniões de diretoria, contribuindo para o alinhamento e desdobramento da estratégia.
  • Atuar como ponte entre a diretoria e a equipe comercial.
  • Conhecer individualmente cada assessor: perfil, ambições, pontos fortes e oportunidades de desenvolvimento.
  • Ser exemplo vivo da cultura e dos valores da empresa.
  • Cuidar do roadmap da equipe, garantindo foco, priorização e qualidade na execução.
  • Desenvolver os liderados por meio de:
  • Feedbacks claros, constantes e estruturados.
  • Incentivo a cursos, leituras, certificações e mentorias.
  • Delegar com eficiência, evitando centralização operacional.
  • Atuar de forma estratégica e tática, não apenas operacional.

  • Ativação de contas.
  • Captação líquida.
  • Receita por produto.
  • Uso e qualidade do CRM.
  • IEA
  • Performance individual e coletiva.
